Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting vehicles from the sales and use tax that are sold or used by qualifying disabled veterans or surviving spouses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting vehicles from the sales and use taxthat are sold or used by qualifying disabled veterans or survivingspouses; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; and adding a newsection to chapter 82.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to the sale ofany vehicle to a qualifying disabled veteran or surviving spouse,provided that the exemption in this subsection may not be claimed by aqualifying disabled veteran or a surviving spouse for more than onevehicle in a consecutive threeyear period. (2) For the purposes of this section, the following definitionsapply, unless the context requires otherwise. (a) "Qualifying disabled veteran" means a veteran meeting thequalifications under RCW 84.36.381(3). (b) "Surviving spouse" means any surviving spouse of a disabledveteran who was eligible to receive an exemption under RCW 84.36.381(3) p. 1 SB 6050at the time of the veteran's death, if the surviving spouse is fiftyseven years of age or older and otherwise meets the requirements of RCW84.36.381(3).

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply in respect to theuse of any vehicle by a qualifying disabled veteran or survivingspouse, provided that the exemption in this subsection may not beclaimed by a qualifying disabled veteran or a surviving spouse for morethan one vehicle in a consecutive threeyear period. (2) "Qualifying disabled veteran" and "surviving spouse" have thesame meanings as provided in section 1 of this act.
